'''Delakroi Paroeidag''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Delakroi Paroeidag appears as the artifice trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
